cohort: 291 preterm infants born at a single center between January 2019 and January 2021, with a gestational age of no more than 32 weeks and a birth weight of no more than 2000 g.
finding: UU infection in preterm infants was associated with increased duration of oxygen and ventilator use, higher levels of leukocytes, platelets, and procalcitonin, and a higher incidence of bronchopulmonary dysplasia, retinopathy of prematurity, and metabolic bone disease.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was an independent risk factor for UU infection.
